info.description: Backend API for the Saaf Islamabad civic issue reporting platform. Citizens can report issues like garbage, broken streetlights, and road damage. Admins assign issues to department staff who resolve them.
info.title: Saaf Islamabad API

get.description: Get paginated assignments. Staff sees own, worker sees own dispatched, admin sees all.

post.description: Creates the staff-level ownership of a report. Optionally a worker can be dispatched immediately by including `worker_id`.

patch.description: The staff owner of an assignment dispatches a worker to physically resolve the report on site. Sets the worker, route info and a location pin.
Mark an assignment as completed without going through the worker upload flow (e.g. desk-resolved).

post.description: Authenticate with phone + password (citizens) or email + password (admin/staff/worker). Provide either `phone`, `email`, or a generic `identifier` along with `password`.
Citizens register with phone + password (Pakistani format). Admin / staff / worker accounts use email + password.
Add a new issue category (admin only)

get.description: All chats the authenticated non-citizen user is part of, most recently active first.

post.description: Returns the existing chat with the participant if one exists, otherwise creates a new conversation. Allowed pairs: admin↔staff and staff↔worker. Citizens are not permitted.

get.description: Returns messages newest-first. Use as the polling fallback when websockets are unavailable.

post.description: Persists the message and pushes it to any websocket subscribers of the receiver in real time. The HTTP endpoint also doubles as the polling fallback when websockets aren't available.
post.summary: Send a message in a conversation

patch.summary: Mark all messages in a conversation as read

get.description: Get notifications for the authenticated user

post.description: Send a notification to a user (admin/system)

patch.description: Mark all notifications as read for the authenticated user
Mark a single notification as read

get.description: Get paginated reports with optional filters
Get aggregate statistics for the dashboard
Get a single report with full details
Get all currently active (non-expired) safety alerts

post.description: Create a safety alert for a critical report (admin only)

get.description: Get a single safety alert by ID

Paginated list of users. Includes the linked department object (not just the id) for staff. Filter by role with `?role=`. Soft-deleted accounts are excluded by default; pass `?include_inactive=true` to include them.

parameters.description: Filter by role (citizen, admin, staff, worker)
parameters.name: role

get.description: Includes the linked department object (not just the id).

delete.description: Anonymises the user's email + name and marks the account inactive. Linked records (reports, assignments, messages, analytics) remain queryable. Admins use this for staff/citizens; staff use DELETE /workers/{id} for workers.

patch.description: Edit any subset of `full_name`, `email`, `phone`, `role`, `department_id`, `is_verified`. The "one active staff per department" rule is enforced: changing a user's role to `staff` and/or moving an active staff member to a new department is rejected if that department already has another active staff member. Cannot change a user's `is_active` flag — use the dedicated soft-delete and reactivate endpoints for that.

Restores a previously deactivated account. The "one active staff per department" rule is re-checked at this point — reactivation will fail with 409 if the user is staff and their department already has another active staff. Anonymised email/phone/name fields are not auto-restored; admin should follow up with PATCH /users/{id} to set fresh contact info if needed.

get.description: Active workers, used by staff to dispatch reports.
Returns all reports dispatched to the authenticated worker, including the report's location and any route info supplied by the dispatching staff.
Fetches a single assignment that belongs to the authenticated worker.

post.description: Worker uploads a multipart/form-data image proving the issue is fixed. The endpoint stores the image, attaches it to the report, transitions the report status to `resolved`, and stamps the assignment as completed.
post.summary: Upload resolution image and mark resolved

patch.description: Worker self-updates their name / phone / email.

delete.description: Staff can remove a worker from their team. The worker is anonymised (email scrubbed, phone nullified, name placeholdered) so historical assignments & analytics still resolve their FK to this user. Allows the email to be reused for re-registration.

route_info.example: Use the back entrance off Margalla Rd
Approach from Street 7, look for the blue gate

message.example: Your report is now in review

resolution_image_url.description:
URL of the resolution image uploaded by the worker once the issue
is fixed on-site. Mirrored onto the report's image set as well.

route_info.description:
Route / location info delivered to the worker. Free-form so staff can
drop a Google Maps link, written directions, or a meeting point.

route_latitude.description:
Latitude/Longitude duplicated from Report at dispatch time so the
worker has an authoritative pin even if the report is later edited.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and your JWT token. Example: **Bearer eyJhbGci...**
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
